Character stays centered around x512; full crown, hair, qin, trailing ribbon, two feet visible with generous margins. Preserve vertical airborne foot clearance. No realism, plastic, tiny low-resolution sprite, duplicate limbs, switched hands, floating instrument, excessive glow, floor, shadows, particle/VFX, lettering, number, border or watermark.
